greet: Hello and welcome in the Gnomprona Gardens. If you want to change your {hazard} level, I 'm who you're looking for.

reply: I can change your hazard level to spice up your hunt in the gardens. Your current level is set to |HAZARD_CURRENT|. And your maximum unlocked level is {|HAZARD_MAXIMUM|}. What level would you like to hunt in?
I'm sorry, I don't understand. What hazard level would you like to set?
Your hazard level has been set to |HAZARD_DESIRED|. Good luck!
You've achieved the necessary hazard level. As a reward, you've received the Noxious Ripptor mount and a primal bag.
You can't set your hazard level higher than your maximum unlocked level.
